passages.title: Public Art Walking Tour
paras: The walking tour meets outside the visitor centre. Weekend tours often fill up, so advance booking is recommended.
The complete route takes about 90 minutes. Visitors should wear comfortable walking shoes.
Tours proceed in light rain but are cancelled during severe weather. Photography is allowed as long as flash is not used inside the gallery.
Groups of ten or more qualify for a discounted rate. The guide pauses at each stop to answer questions.

passages.title: Pet Care Boarding Centre
passages.intro: How to access the service and what to expect
paras: Owners must present current vaccination records at check-in. Food brought from home should be labelled with the pet's name.
Staff require written instructions for any medication. Morning drop-off takes place between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m.
An additional charge may apply to pick-ups after 6 p.m. Owners must provide an emergency contact who can be reached during the stay.
The boarding centre supplies bedding for all animals. Any behavioural concerns should be discussed before the booking begins.
